Top 10 Enamelled Copper Wire Manufacturers 2022

2022-08-01

Do you want to grow your business? Choose the best enamelled copper wire manufacturer and supplier to support your business!

Please read this list of the enamelled copper wire manufacturers. It will tell you what are the outstanding enamelled copper wire manufacturers!

Hi-Wire(UK)

MWS(USA)

RR SHRAMIK(India)

SWAN(China)

Scientific(UK)

Salzer(India, Bangalore)

Dahrén(Sweden)

ELEKTRISOLA(Germany)

ASC(India)

KWW(India)

1. Hi-Wire

Introduction:

Besides its uses in the energy transformation, magnet wire is vital to a wide range of communications applications. Magnet wire is used in coils in products such as computers, telephones, cell phones, video games and televisions.

Hi-Wire is the largest stockist of industry standard enamelled wires in the UK and it can utilize the Essex group's global manufacturing facilities to supply more bespoke wire products.

Location: UK

Main Products:

Round enamelled copper wire

Rectangular enamelled copper wire

Get a Quote

2. MWS

Introduction:

Established in 1968, MWS has built its reputation on delivering wire sourcing solutions for its customers. With the largest, most varied inventory of magnet wire and specialty wire found anywhere, chances are good we already have exactly what you need. But if we don’t, we’ll find it or make it.

Video:

Location: USA

Get a Quote

3. RR SHRAMIK

Introduction:

From a modest beginning in 1965 as a small electrical trading shop in the erstwhile city of Bombay, to be India’s leading manufacturer of winding wires today, it has been a very fulfilling journey for RR Shramik. It’s India’s only manufacturer of enameled copper wires that offers the widest range starting from 0.018 mm to 4.876 mm (SWG 06 – 52) with additional intermediate and mm sizes.

Video:

Location: India

Main Products:

Super Enamelled Copper Wires

Fine & Ultrafine Enamelled Copper Wires

Super Enamelled Aluminium Winding Wires

Nylon Coated Enamelled Wires

Get a Quote

Introduction:

SWAN INT'L, based in Shanghai, is the manufacturer and exporter of wire, cable, and its manufacturing equipment; the company also provides the consulting service for international bidding projects, Chinese supplier sourcing service for the industrial products supply chain development. The company has developed its business with more than 100 overseas clients in more than 20 countries and regions such as Germany, Italy, Brazil, Southeast Asia, Russia, Turkey, the Middle East Region, Africa, etc.

5. Scientific

Introduction:

We are one of the foremost suppliers in the UK of enamelled copper wire, stranded and coloured wire, rectangular enamelled or Nomex covered copper, bare/tinned / silver & gold plated copper wires and a huge range of resistance wires. We also stock other types of wires.

Location: UK

6. Salzer

Introduction:

We offer our clients high quality enameled copper wires that are manufactured from 99.97% pure ETP grade copper and insulated with high temperature engineered enamel. It is made as per NEMA standards.

Location: India, Bangalor

Get a Quote

7. Dahrén

Introduction:

Dahrén is a leading global supplier of copper and aluminum winding wire solutions. With facilities in Sweden, Germany and Poland we offer a complete high quality product range for a worldwide market. With in-depth knowledge, local presence and substantial capability and flexibility – we can handle complex, customer specific orders and offer a leading edge service and support organization.

Location: Sweden

Main Products:

Round enamelled copper wire

Rectangular enamelled copper wire

Round enamelled aluminium wire

Rectangular enamelled aluminium wire

Get a Quote

8. ELEKTRISOLA

Introduction:

There is a big variety of enameled wire types available. The different insulations are described in different standards, such as IEC 60317 (Asia or Europe), NEMA MW 1000 (USA) and JIS C 3202 (Japan) which sometimes still use different test methods.

Location: Germany

Get a Quote

9. ASC

Introduction:

Enameled Copper Wire also is known as Winding Wire or Magnet Wire, is an insulated round copper conductor used in motors, transformers, and other electromechanical equipment As one of the leading Enameled Copper Wire manufacturers in India, Amardeep Steel Center has developed a full range of copper winding wires to meet its customer's requirements and applications. The

offered enameled copper wires or magnet wires meet all requirements and applications where there is a need to boost manufacturing efficiency.

Location: India

Get a Quote

10. KWW

Introduction:

Khaitan Winding Wire Pvt. Ltd. (KWW) was set up in the year 1995 for the manufacturing of Magnet Wire. The other products include Winding Wire made of copper – round & rectangular strips, paper insulated copper strips, bare copper wire, copper tapes, copper flats, bunched copper wire and more. The company was promoted by Mr. Ajit Kumar Khaitan and Mr. Pradeep Kumar Khaitan.

Location: India

Get a Quote

The Bottom Line

We have discussed the top 10 manufacturers of enamelled copper wire. All these companies provide high quality enamelled copper wire. All have a different design, technology, benefits, etc. But the most important thing is their support and reliability. They make enamelled copper wire according to safety standards.

If you have enamelled copper wire needs, you can (https://www.srmindustry.com/Contact-Us/) contact us, we will provide you with help and give you the best solution.
